_comment: Committed result of `layout/erc/well_tap_audit.py` -- the direct
geometric answer to `does ADC_BLOCK draw well or substrate taps at
all?`, which `klt erc`'s `erc.missing_tie` check cannot give on this
stream (see ../README.md and issue #340).
This file is BOTH the record and the expectation. `well_tap_audit.py`
re-derives every value under `measured` from the GDS named below and
fails if any of them moved, so the decision that rests on these
numbers (spec/decision-records/DR-0032-implant-layers-not-drawn.md)
cannot be silently invalidated by a later layout edit.
HOW TO READ THE TWO HEADLINE NUMBERS.
well_tap_candidates: 0
Of the 160 `COMP` 22/0 polygons that interact with an `Nwell`
21/0 island, ZERO fail to also interact with `Poly2` 30/0. Every
diffusion region inside every well in this block is transistor
source/drain/channel. No n-well tap is drawn anywhere in
ADC_BLOCK -- which is a fact about the drawn layout, established
without any implant layer, extraction deck or net model.
substrate_tie_candidates: 2
The two contacted `Comp`/`Contact`/`Metal1` guard rings
`lib/geometry.py:draw_guard_ring` draws, one around the analog
core and one around the reserved digital region. They ARE real
substrate-tie structures -- and `metal1_label_texts: 0` on both
says neither carries a label `klt erc` could resolve to a
supply, while `metal1_bar_pairs_touching: 0` says each ring's
four Metal1 bars are mutually disjoint: the Metal1 ring is open
at all four corners, so strapping one bar would not strap the
ring. Tracked as its own layout work, not decided here.
contact_min_dim_um / contact_max_dim_um
Each ring's contacts are drawn as four long bars (0.468 um x up
to 596.698 um), not as arrays of 0.22 um squares. They pass the
curated deck's `contact.width.1`, which is a MINIMUM-width check
whose own description calls itself an approximation of
gf180mcu's CO.1 exact min/max size rule. Recorded here because
an audit of tap structures that did not notice would be worth
less; tracked with the strapping work rather than fixed here.
LAYER NUMBERS come from the same two cross-checked sources
adc_block.supply-spec.json's own `_comment` names: the installed PDK's
gf180mcu.lyp layer table and klayout-tools' curated gf180mcu deck.
`pplus` 31/0 and `nplus` 32/0 are listed even though this stream
carries neither -- their absence is one of the measured facts.
